description: This file implements Synthetic Initialization Vector (SIV) mode for deterministic authenticated encryption, including functions for encryption, decryption, initialization, and internal cryptographic operations using OpenSSL. It features support for multiple key sizes, compatibility layers for different OpenSSL versions, and includes detailed cryptographic procedures based on the S2V construction.

methods.name: void aes_encrypt_block(const unsigned char * in,unsigned char * out,SIV_KEY_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Encrypts a single block of data using AES, supporting different OpenSSL versions.

methods.name: int aes_init(const unsigned char * key,const int bits,SIV_KEY_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Initializes an AES encryption context with the given key and key size, supporting different OpenSSL versions.

methods.name: void xor(unsigned char * output,const unsigned char * input)
methods.description: Performs an XOR operation on two blocks of AES_BLOCK_SIZE bytes.

methods.name: void times_two(unsigned char * output,unsigned char * input)
methods.description: Computes the doubling (polynomial multiplication by 2) of a block as used in CMAC and S2V.

methods.name: void pad(unsigned char * buf,int len)
methods.description: Pads a buffer to the AES_BLOCK_SIZE using the ISO/IEC 7816-4 padding scheme.

methods.name: void aes_cmac(siv_ctx * ctx,const unsigned char * msg,int mlen,unsigned char * C)
methods.description: Calculates AES-CMAC over a message per NIST SP 800-38B.

methods.name: int s2v_final(siv_ctx * ctx,const unsigned char * X,int xlen,unsigned char * digest)
methods.description: Processes the final input into the S2V construct to generate an authentication tag.

methods.name: void s2v_add(siv_ctx * ctx,const unsigned char * Y)
methods.description: Adds a preprocessed block into the S2V state.

methods.name: void s2v_update(siv_ctx * ctx,const unsigned char * X,int xlen)
methods.description: Updates the S2V with additional data to be authenticated.

methods.name: int siv_init(siv_ctx * ctx,const unsigned char * key,int keylen)
methods.description: Initializes the SIV context with the cryptographic keys.

methods.name: void siv_restart(siv_ctx * ctx)
methods.description: Resets the SIV context for a fresh encryption/decryption operation.

methods.name: void s2v_benchmark(siv_ctx * ctx)
methods.description: Saves the current S2V state for later reuse to optimize processing.

methods.name: void s2v_reset(siv_ctx * ctx)
methods.description: Restores the S2V state from a previously saved benchmark.

methods.name: void siv_aes_ctr(siv_ctx * ctx,const unsigned char * p,const int lenp,unsigned char * c,const unsigned char * iv)
methods.description: Performs AES-CTR mode encryption/decryption for the SIV mode, supporting OpenSSL 3.0+ and legacy versions.

methods.name: int siv_encrypt(siv_ctx * ctx,const unsigned char * p,unsigned char * c,const int len,unsigned char * counter,const int nad,...)
methods.description: Encrypts data using SIV mode, producing a synthetic IV and ciphertext.

methods.name: int siv_decrypt(siv_ctx * ctx,const unsigned char * c,unsigned char * p,const int len,unsigned char * counter,const int nad,...)
methods.description: Decrypts ciphertext in SIV mode after verifying the authentication tag.

methods.name: void siv_free(siv_ctx * ctx)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with an SIV context.
